a11y_responsive.evidence: Audit contact.html: blockers 0, contrast 0/61 desktop and 0/59 mobile, focus_invisible 0 of 25, unnamed_controls 0, h1 1, heading_skips 0, lang/title/viewport true, landmarks main+nav+footer, horizontal_overflow false at 375, tap_targets_under_24 0, tap_targets_under_44 1. desktop_fold/s01: labels sit above 48px inputs; tel/mailto/wa.me and PDF are real hrefs; skip link in source. tablet_full: .cols stacks (form then reach), .row2 stays two fields from 768px, Menu is a named 44px button. mobile_full: single-column reflow, 56px Call/WhatsApp .bar, body 16px, no clip the audit can measure. focus.png: 3px :focus-visible ring on the header quote button. factory_map/office_map: iframes titled as demanded; grey slabs are capture artefacts. Waived: no consent checkbox, square buttons, no header phone, hover wipe #000.
strengths: Zero contrast fails, 25/25 visible focus, skip+one h1+named Menu, labelled fields with autocomplete
375px reflows instead of shrinking; 48px inputs; 56px Call/WhatsApp bar; tel/mailto/wa.me anchors
Both maps have iframe titles; aria-invalid and role=status on submit; prefers-reduced-motion rule

issues.problem: Audit still counts 1 control under 44px on desktop and mobile. Footer type is 12.5px with padding 0 4px, so About is under 44px wide.
issues.fix: On .foot nav a and .foot-meta a set min-width:44px and padding-inline:var(--s3).

issues.problem: The banner says call or WhatsApp +91 97277 02597 as plain text. Desktop_fold shows it; it is not tappable. Sidebar and .bar are linked, the hero number is not.
issues.fix: Wrap the digits in +91 97277 02597 inside the pagehead paragraph.

issues.problem: Label reads Quantity (MT) * but the input has no required attribute (name and phone do). On error, JS sets aria-describedby to form-status only, dropping quantity-hint.
issues.fix: Add required to #quantity. On invalid, set aria-describedby to "quantity-hint form-status" (append, do not replace).

issues.problem: Two Google Maps embeds are in-page (demanded) and titled, but there is no skip-past-map link. Keyboard users hit a long run of map chrome twice before the footer.
issues.fix: Before each iframe add Skip map (and a matching office target) and put those ids on the next heading.
